_status: DRAFT — proposed, not approved. Merge into requirements.json only after review.
_note: GEO-001, TREE-001, EVID-001 and EVID-002 are ALREADY APPROVED in the package. They are not restated here. These entries add what those requirements need in order to be satisfiable.

requirements.title: Evidence assets are content-addressed and verified on completion
requirements.rationale: EVID-002 requires immutable cryptographically hashed originals but defines no upload operation. Two-phase upload with server-side digest verification is what makes the existing EVIDENCE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH error reachable. Bytes go straight to object storage and never through the API process.

requirements.title: Evidence is superseded, never deleted
requirements.rationale: An evidence record that can be edited or removed is not evidence. Corrections supersede. OPEN QUESTION: photographs may contain identifiable people and data protection law may compel deletion — see open question 5.

requirements.title: Parcels exist as first-class records with an approval lifecycle
requirements.rationale: GEO-001 approves append-only parcel boundaries and traceability.csv names forests.parcel_boundaries, but no parcel table was ever created. Submission and approval are distinct operations because parcel.approve_boundary is already approved as critical with aal3 and dual control.

requirements.title: Boundary geometry is stored as WGS84 geography
requirements.rationale: GEOGRAPHY(POLYGON, 4326) gives correct area and distance over large tropical extents without committing to a local projection. Areas are computed by the database, never supplied by the client, so a claimed hectare figure cannot disagree with the geometry it came from.

requirements.title: A tree is a durable identity; its condition is an observation series
requirements.rationale: TREE-001 requires permanent tree history. Identity that rarely changes is separated from measurements and photographs that change often, so a tree's history is a first-class query rather than something reconstructed from an audit log.

requirements.title: Public tree locations may be reduced in precision
requirements.rationale: Publishing exact coordinates of high-value timber endangers the trees and the people who tend them. Precision reduction is a property of the record, applied on read, not a rendering choice left to each client.

requirements.title: Every observation cites the evidence it rests on
requirements.rationale: EVID-001 requires material claims to trace to evidence. Any claim shown to a sponsor about a tree's condition must reference the evidence asset supporting it, or it must not be shown.
